locator.precision: Approximate analyst-selected point at the KDDI-identified converted factory property within the historical Green Front Sakai complex, rounded to four decimals and used only as a campus locator. It is not an operator-published pin, surveyed centroid, parcel boundary, occupied server-room footprint or marker for the whole historical Sharp complex.
locator.identity_review: The January KDDI release and Spark Journal article explicitly name Osaka Sakai Data Center and show the same KDDI-branded former factory block from different angles. The roof cooling spine, eastern office bars, north waterfront road, southern service corridor and western open strip match the Esri image. CBRE, the acquisition adviser, identifies the acquired property as the former color-filter production facility, with about 33,000 square metres of land and 57,000 square metres of floor area. Sharp confirms the April 4, 2025 transfer to KDDI. SoftBank separately contracted for about 450,000 square metres of land and 840,000 square metres of buildings; its project is not this KDDI property.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Imagery acquisition date and absolute positional accuracy are unestablished. Roof parallax, historical changes and manual matching introduce unquantified uncertainty. Pixel resolution and decimal places are not measured ground accuracy.

visual_identity_matches: KDDI labels both exterior photographs with the exact Osaka Sakai facility name.
Both views show the same simple rectangular block with a long central rooftop cooling spine and different perspectives on its narrow end and long flank.
The Esri block sits immediately south of a waterfront road and north of the major east-west factory service corridor.
Office bars lie immediately east of the block; an open former development strip is immediately west. The southeast approach includes a small roundabout.
The larger historical LCD panel factory lies beyond the service corridor to the southwest; its roof and utility block appear in the operator context.

independent_root_review: Root independently viewed both KDDI-labelled exterior photos and the georeferenced Esri image. Distinct central roof equipment spine, office bars, waterfront road, service corridor and western open strip match. Root reproduced [135.43971178571428,34.59709892857143] using the declared +0.5 pixel-center convention and rounded to [135.4397,34.5971]. Point lies within the identified property image; no cadastral boundary, occupied floor extent, acquisition date, surveyed precision or status is inferred from imagery.
